title: StartTurnResult
description:
Result of the `engine/start_turn` RPC.

# Examples

``` use std::sync::Arc; use zhive_proto::domain::TurnId; use zhive_proto::rpc::StartTurnResult; let r = StartTurnResult::new(TurnId(Arc::from("turn:t/0"))); let v = serde_json::to_value(&r).unwrap(); assert_eq!(v["turnId"], "turn:t/0"); let back: StartTurnResult = serde_json::from_value(v).unwrap(); assert_eq!(back, r); ```
